config.record_grain: One row per ACNC-registered charity/legal entity, primarily identified by the source ABN; names, business address and charity attributes describe that charity record.

fields.evidence: User guide, p. 2, §§6-7: ABN is a charity's Australian Business Number and the field is numeric; discovery sample header ABN with sample 51214424410.
User guide, p. 2, §§8-9: Charity name is the formal name appearing on legal or official documents; exact header Charity_Legal_Name and sample U3A Inner North Incorporated.

User guide, p. 2, §§10-11: other organisation names may be trading names or other names and are names by which the charity is known; exact header Other_Organisation_Names and sample Georges Riverkeeper.

User guide, p. 2, §§12-14: Charity address is the business address and address lines 1-3 are supplied address fields; exact headers Address_Line_1, Address_Line_2, Address_Line_3 and sample 540 Regency Rd.
User guide, p. 2, §13 lists Town/City as an address field; exact header Town_City and sample Enfield.
User guide, p. 2, §13 lists State as an address field; exact header State and samples SA and VIC.
User guide, p. 2, §13 lists Postcode as an address field; exact header Postcode and sample 5085.
User guide, p. 2, §13 lists Country as an address field; exact header Country and sample Australia.
User guide, p. 2, §15: Charity website contains the supplied website address; exact header Charity_Website and samples https://www.u3ainnernorth.org.au/ and www.spectrum3.org.au.

limitations: The source is a subset of the ACNC Charity Register and may omit records or fields withheld by charities; absence is not evidence of nonexistence.
The publication proxy 2026-09-13T19:00:54.497199 is used because the source envelope supplies publication metadata and no record-level observation timestamp is present.
The preview contains six records while analysis reports a 300-record discovery set; full-file duplicate, blank-identifier and anomaly checks were not established.
No entity status, entity type, ACN, industry code or legal-entity registration date is explicitly supplied; these remain unmapped.
Other organisation names are retained as trading-name observations but are not treated as separate legal entities.
All authority and field confidence scores are provisional and require human review.
